title: MiniGame Pack Lite
description: A lightweight Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge modpack focused on better FPS, smoother mouse input, cleaner visuals, and simple PvP quality-of-life features.
body:
**MiniGame Pack Lite** is a simple and lightweight Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge modpack designed for players who want better performance, smoother controls, and a cleaner PvP experience.

This pack focuses on basic optimization and quality-of-life improvements without adding too many unnecessary features. It is useful for 1.8.9 PvP, BedWars, Hypixel-style gameplay, and general multiplayer use.

**Features:**

* Better FPS and overall performance improvements
* Smoother mouse control with raw input support
* Toggle sprint for easier movement
* Reduced camera shake when taking damage
* Cleaner and customizable particles
* Minimap and world map support
* Lower background resource usage
* Extra visual and performance fixes
* Simple 16x PvP resource pack included

This modpack is client-side only and is made for players who want a clean, optimized Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge setup.

**Included Mods:**

**BetterSprint**
Adds toggle sprint, making movement easier and more comfortable during PvP.

**BetterFps**
Improves Minecraft performance and helps increase FPS.

**Raw Input**
Improves mouse precision by using direct mouse input.

**FoamFix**
Reduces memory usage and helps improve overall performance.

**Entity Culling**
Stops rendering entities that are not visible, helping improve FPS.

**Phosphor**
Improves lighting performance and reduces lag caused by lighting updates.

**FPS Reducer**
Lowers resource usage when Minecraft is unfocused or idle.

**NoHurtCamFix**
Removes the camera shake effect when taking damage, making PvP feel smoother.

**OverflowParticles**
Allows particle customization for cleaner PvP visuals.

**ConfigurationsBackport**
Adds support needed by some optimization and configuration mods.

**Xaero’s Minimap**
Adds a minimap for easier navigation.

**Xaero’s World Map**
Adds a full-screen world map.

**OneConfig**
Provides configuration support for several modern 1.8.9 mods.

**Blade 16x Resource Pack**
A simple PvP-style resource pack included with the modpack.
